resolved_failure.cause: The overwrite fingerprint contained a nanosecond timestamp beyond JavaScript exact-integer range. Browser JSON parsing changed it, so the accepted confirmation was rejected as a concurrent destination change.
resolved_failure.fix: Opaque SHA-256 string token; the existing concurrent-change and original-source protections remain.
resolved_failure.resolution: Restarted the production server, reopened the exact successful six-mode project, accepted replacement of the existing generated CSV, and independently read all 375 retained rows from the saved file. The continuation asserted an opaque string token and a successful save response.

actual_browser_workflow.method: The initial browser run completed import, point/model measurements, visibility, full-density edit, six numerical comparisons, heatmap colour changes, result CSV, and scene removal/Undo. It paused on the overwrite defect. Its workspace was saved as a named snapshot and the continuation completed export, persisted-result reopen, scale and responsive layout checks after the fix; no numerical engine changes occurred between these phases.
limitations: Actual Chromium on Linux with software WebGL and small synthetic files; this does not certify Windows native dialogs or native DPI behavior.
The numerical and full real-scan gates are reported separately by the backend verification.
Stage counts describe executed browser checks, not a claim of distinct mathematical algorithms.
Screenshots are internal QA material and are not release deliverables.

cloud_reference_performance.scope: Exact comparison throughput on all10,125,420 real reference points with25k offset queries and75k unchanged queries; no550M throughput or whole-app memory claim.
changes: Group up to25,000 queries before the tree traversal to avoid repeated leaf-tree construction.
Retain exact leaf indexes in a fixed512MiB component-estimate LRU budget, with at most one new leaf construction in addition.
An exact zero distance requires no second traversal; unresolved queries retain exact conservative box pruning.
All retained finite reference points remain indexed; no reference subsampling or approximate nearest-neighbour search.
cloud_reference_performance.cache_accounting: Owned float64XYZ + native integer permutation +128bytes per native node +4KiB per cache entry. The bundled SciPy1.17 node serialization was measured at72bytes/node. This estimates those cache components; it is not a process memory cap.
